SEARCH
Package services

Class MastodonClient

java.lang.Object
services.MastodonClient
@Singleton public final class MastodonClient extends Object
Retrieves one bounded Mastodon timeline page using non-blocking Play WS calls.

AI assistance: implementation support for Phase 4 asynchronous requests, external configuration, and controlled failures.

Author:
Nabeel Ali

  • Method Details

    • fetchPosts

      public CompletionStage<List<Post>> fetchPosts(String hashtag, String maxId)
      Fetches at most 40 posts without waiting for the network response. The search service will apply full hashtag validation and caching.
      Parameters:
      hashtag - the hashtag without its leading hash
      maxId - an optional pagination cursor; null or blank means the first page
      Returns:
      an asynchronous post list or a failed stage containing a safe error
      Author:
      Nabeel Ali
